chunks.text: Today we will talk about the Maldives.
The Maldives is a small beautiful and tropical island country in South Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is the Maldives?
The Maldives is in the Indian Ocean southwest of India and Sri Lanka.
It is made of about one 200 small islands.
Only about 200 islands have people living on them.
Most of the country is ocean and coral reefs.
What is the capital of the Maldives?
The capital city is Malay.
Malay is a small busy city with boats, markets and mosques.
It is one of the most crowded capitals in the world.
Many people also live on nearby islands.
How many people live in the Maldives?
About 500,000 people live in the Maldives.
Most people live on the capital island or on bigger islands.
Many people work in tourism, fishing and boat services.
What language do people speak in the Maldives?
The official language is Divehi.
It is a language only spoken in the Maldives.
Many people also speak English, especially in tourist areas and schools.
What is the weather like in the Maldives?
The Maldives has a hot and tropical climate.
It is warm all year.
There are two main seasons, dry season from November to April, rainy season from May to October.
There is a lot of sunshine but also some rain and wind.
What does the Maldives look like?
The Maldives has white sand beaches, clear blue water, palm trees and tropical plants, coral reefs and colorful fish.
The islands are flat and very close to sea level.
Climate change is a big danger for the Maldives.
What animals live in the Maldives?
The Maldives has many sea animals such as colorful fish, sea turtles, dolphins and whales, manta rays and sharks, crabs, octopus and coral.
On land, you can find birds, lizards and bats but there are no large wild animals.
What do people eat in the Maldives?
Maldivian food is simple, fresh and often made with fish.
People eat fish, especially tuna, rice and flatbread.
Coconut used in many dishes, chili, lime and onion.
Popular dishes, Mas juni shredded tuna with coconut, onion and chili.
Roshi flatbread eaten with curry, Garudia fish soup, Bajia snacks like samosas filled with fish or vegetables.
What do people drink in the Maldives?
People drink water, black tea often with sugar and milk, coconut water fresh from the coconut, fruit juice, mango, papaya or watermelon.
Because the Maldives is a Muslim country, alcohol is not common except at resorts for tourists.
What is life like in the Maldives?
Life is peaceful, simple and community based.
People enjoy fishing and boating, spending time with family, swimming and walking on the beach, playing sports, especially football and volleyball, relaxing in the evening with tea and snacks.
What are some holidays and traditions in the Maldives?
Independence Day, July 26, Republic Day, November 11, Ramadan and Eid, important Islamic holidays.
National Day, a day for culture and history.
People wear traditional clothes, cook special meals and visit family and friends.
Some fun facts about the Maldives.
The Maldives is the lowest country in the world, only one to two meters above sea level.
Many houses are built close to the water.
The flag is red with a green rectangle and a white crescent moon.
Tourists love the Maldives for snorkeling, diving and relaxing.
Traditional boats are called Donis.
Now you know many things about the Maldives.
You know where it is, what people speak and what they eat.
You learned about the islands, the ocean and daily life.
Great job.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English podcast.
I am Emily.
